profiles.notes: Technical eligibility for international qualifications in the 2026/27 cycle. Check each credential’s requirements and the target programme.

requirements.label: AP · exam combinations and published minimum
requirements.details: Where the standardised-test requirement applies, submit five accepted AP exams, or at least three accepted AP exams plus SAT or ACT with Writing. Each AP exam requires grade 3 or above. NUS accepts at most two AP sittings.

source.title: NUS December 2025 standardised test requirements, PDF pp. 1–2

requirements.label: AP · calculus and programme prerequisites
requirements.details: The AP route requires Calculus BC except for Law, which can use an accepted subject combination including Calculus AB. AP subjects must also cover any subject prerequisites for the intended programme.

source.title: NUS December 2025 standardised test requirements, PDF pp. 1–2

requirements.label: AP · accepted subjects
requirements.details: NUS lists Art History, Music Theory, English Language and Composition, English Literature and Composition, European History, United States History, World History: Modern, Human Geography, Macroeconomics, Microeconomics, Psychology, Computer Science A, Calculus BC, Statistics, Biology, Chemistry, Environmental Science, Physics 1, Physics 2, Physics C: Electricity and Magnetism, Physics C: Mechanics, Chinese, French, German, Italian, Latin, Japanese, Spanish Language and Culture, and Spanish Literature and Culture.

source.title: NUS December 2025 standardised test requirements, accepted AP courses, PDF p. 3

requirements.label: SAT · minimum scores when paired with AP
requirements.details: NUS lists a minimum of 600 in Reading and Writing and 650 in Mathematics, achieved in one sitting. The SAT scores are valid for five years.

source.title: NUS December 2025 standardised test requirements, PDF pp. 1–2

requirements.label: ACT with Writing · minimum scores when paired with AP
requirements.details: NUS lists a minimum ACT composite score of 29 and Writing score of 8. Take all sections and Writing in a single sitting. The ACT scores are valid for five years.

source.title: NUS December 2025 standardised test requirements, PDF pp. 1–2

requirements.label: AP, SAT and ACT · official score reporting
requirements.details: Send applicable official score reports to NUS through College Board (code 3720 for AP and SAT) or ACT (code 5286). Also upload the relevant score reports to the Applicant Portal.

source.title: NUS December 2025 standardised test requirements, PDF pp. 1–2

requirements.label: American high school diploma · eligibility and tests
requirements.details: The American diploma route requires a good high school pass and standardised test scores. Candidates completing high school after the deadline submit their latest high school results and the grading scale. The 2026 rules exclude those pending-result applicants from Dentistry, Law and Medicine.

source.title: NUS 2026 American High School Diploma admissions table

requirements.label: International A-level · completed and pending results
requirements.details: The detailed admissions table lists good passes in at least four full Advanced Level subjects, with final grades available by end July 2026 for the pending-results route. Applicants with final results have no additional standardised-test requirement in that table. Those applying with pending final results submit AS results and standardised tests and are ineligible for Dentistry, Law or Medicine.

source.title: NUS 2026 International A-level admissions table

requirements.label: International A-level · sittings, boards and Edexcel cash-in
requirements.details: NUS considers final Advanced Level grades across at most two examination sessions and two examination boards within 12 months. Edexcel International A-level grades must be cashed in. Cambridge AICE holders can apply.

source.title: NUS 2026 International A-level admissions, accepted grades and notes

requirements.label: International A-level · alternate wording in the 2026/27 prospectus
requirements.details: The prospectus lists at least three full Advanced Level results with good grades in four preferred. The dedicated table lists four good passes. Confirm how NUS applies these two published descriptions to a three-subject application.

source.title: NUS international undergraduate prospectus 2026/27, printed pp. 10–11

profiles.notes: NUS instructions for the 2027/28 IB admissions cycle.

requirements.label: IB · application window
requirements.details: The published application window opens 16 December 2026 and closes 17 February 2027.

source.title: NUS 2027/28 important dates, IB Diploma column

requirements.label: IB · May 2027 transcript and personal code
requirements.details: May 2027 candidates submit school-attested predicted results, add their IB Personal Code by 16 June 2027, and authorise NUS to receive the official transcript by 6 July 2027. The institution code is 000690.

source.title: NUS IB admissions, May 2027 examination session

requirements.label: IB · English test for non-English instruction
requirements.details: NUS asks IB Diploma candidates to provide an English language test result when three or more IB subjects were taught in a language other than English.

source.title: NUS IB admissions, English test condition

requirements.label: IB · Mother Tongue Language
requirements.details: The rule applies to Singapore citizens and permanent residents, plus international applicants from listed Singapore independent or specialised schools. An SL or HL pass in an eligible mother tongue A or B subject can fulfil it. SL ab initio does not fulfil it. The admissions page lists other approved evidence and exemption routes.

source.title: NUS IB admissions, Mother Tongue Language section

profiles.notes: Additional rules for applicants presenting predicted May 2027 IB Diploma results.

requirements.label: May 2027 IB · supplementary test requirements
requirements.details: Submit school-endorsed predicted IB results, AP exam results, and either SAT or ACT with Writing by 17 February 2027.

source.title: NUS IB admissions, additional Dentistry and Medicine requirements

profiles.notes: Additional rules for applicants presenting predicted May 2027 IB Diploma results.

requirements.label: May 2027 IB · supplementary test requirements
requirements.details: Submit school-endorsed predicted IB results by 17 February 2027 along with UCAT UK/ANZ, or with AP exams plus either SAT or ACT with Writing.

source.title: NUS IB admissions, additional Dentistry and Medicine requirements
